about.bio:
I'm Gabriele, a fullstack developer. I mostly work on business software and enterprise applications: Java, Spring Boot and Kotlin on the backend, Angular on the frontend, and whatever it takes for the two to work well together.
I like following a project from start to finish, deploy included: I've used Linux for years and I'm happy to deal with containers, Kubernetes and servers. Outside work, I also contribute to a few open source projects.

skyblockpuro.description: Founded the Minecraft server SkyBlockPuro. Responsible for the entire technical infrastructure: DDoS protection, proxy management, version updates, custom Java plugin development, and coordination of external contributors.

r1se.description: Developed backend software for internal company utilities. Set up the initial cloud infrastructure on AWS using EC2 instances.

sandrini.description: Backend development of an ERP management system using Java and Spring Boot. ERP frontend development with Angular and TypeScript. CI/CD pipeline implementation. Development of an integrative ERP mobile app with Flutter (Android). PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MariaDB, and Redis database management. Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Proxmox.

metamc.description: Developed Java plugins for Minecraft servers handling 150+ concurrent active players. Responsible for server infrastructure management and development team supervision.

devroom.description: Commission-based work for the devroom team: mod development, server configurations, and custom plugins.
